name: RevitMCPCommandSet
description: Basic command collection for Revit AI assistance

commands.description: Displays a greeting dialog
get available family types
get current view elements
get current view info
get selected elements
Create point-based elements like furniture
Create line based element such as wall
Create surface-based elements like floors
Color elements by parameter value
Tag all the walls in the model
Deletes elements using ElementId
AI element filter for querying elements by criteria
Operate on elements (select, color, hide, isolate, etc)
Extract all rooms with detailed properties including area, volume, perimeter, and parameters
Calculate material quantities and takeoffs with area and volume calculations per material
Analyze model complexity with element counts by category, type, family, and level
Create grid system with smart spacing generation for project layout (alphabetic/numeric naming)
Create structural beam framing system with configurable spacing and direction
Create and place rooms at specified locations with custom names, numbers, and properties
Create tags for all rooms in the current view displaying room name and number
Create levels at specified elevations with automatic floor plan view generation
Execute dynamic C# code in Revit with access to the Document and Revit API
Create dimension annotations between elements or points in the current view
Create reference planes by line, by origin+normal, or by three points (mm). Returns created element IDs
Create shared parameter definitions and bind them to categories (instance or type). Reuses existing definitions/bindings
Universal parameter writer: set instance/type parameters by name or BuiltInParameter across many elements (mm/deg in). Returns per-element report
Create a ParameterFilterElement with AND-combined rules and apply it to a view with graphic overrides. Updates existing filter of same name
Create global parameters, set values, and associate them to element parameters. Per-association validation and error reporting
Read instance and type parameters from elements (names, values, storage types, units). Read-back companion to set_element_parameters
Move, rotate, mirror, copy or array a batch of elements (mm/deg). Returns new element ids for copy/array
Create a view: FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, AreaPlan, Section, Elevation, 3D, or Drafting. Resolves level/view-family-type by name; optional scale and template
Create a sheet from a title block (resolved by name) and optionally auto-place views as viewports in a grid
Place one or more views as viewports on an existing sheet, at a given center or auto-arranged in a grid
Tag elements in a view by explicit ids or by category (generalizes tag_walls/tag_rooms). Picks a sensible tag type when none given
Return the model's warnings (Document.GetWarnings) grouped by description with counts, severity, and sample affected element ids
Create straight ducts from start/end points (mm) with a system type, duct type and level (resolved by name). Sets diameter or width/height per segment
Create straight pipes from start/end points (mm) with a piping system type, pipe type and level (resolved by name). Sets diameter per segment
Create straight conduits from start/end points (mm) with a conduit type and level (resolved by name). Optional diameter
Create straight cable trays from start/end points (mm) with a cable tray type and level (resolved by name). Sets width/height
Place a loadable family (MEP equipment/fixture/device, resolved by name) at points (mm) on a level, with optional Z rotation
Create MEP spaces at points (mm) on a level, or auto-place spaces in all enclosed regions. Optional tagging
Read the MEP system an element belongs to (or is): name, type, member element ids and flow. Read-only review tool
Create straight walls from start/end points (mm) with a wall type and level (resolved by name). Per-segment or default height, base offset, flip, structural flag
Create a floor from a closed boundary of points (mm) with a floor type and level (resolved by name)
Create a ceiling from a closed boundary of points (mm) with a ceiling type and level (resolved by name). Requires Revit 2022+
Create rooms at points (mm) on a level with optional names and tags, or auto-place rooms in all enclosed regions
Create an opening in a host: rectangular in a wall (two corners) or a vertical shaft through floors/roofs using the boundary profile (mm)
Load a family (.rfa) from an absolute path into the project, overwriting if it exists. Returns the family id and its type ids
Place instances of a loaded family type (resolved by name) at points (mm) on a level or host, with optional Z rotation and structural type
List loaded family types (FamilySymbols), optionally filtered by category and family name, optionally with each type's parameters. Read-only
Duplicate a loaded family type to a new named type and apply parameter overrides (mm/deg). Project context
Add a parameter to the family being edited (Family Editor only; guarded by IsFamilyDocument). Optional formula. Multi-version (ForgeTypeId 2022+)
Add a new type to the family being edited (FamilyManager.NewType). Family Editor only
Set or clear a formula on a family parameter (FamilyManager.SetFormula). Family Editor only
Delete elements by id (and their dependents). Returns count removed
Duplicate any ElementType (resolved by name) to a new named type and apply parameter overrides (mm/deg)
Group elements together into a model group; optional name
Ungroup one or more groups into their member elements
Pin or unpin elements (lock position)
Rename an element or type by id
Copy parameter values from a source element to many targets (named params, or all writable)
Set a parameter on all elements matching given categories (optionally active view only). Name or BuiltInParameter; mm/deg
List the parameters available on a category (sampled from an element): names, storage types, read-only, type-vs-instance
Create a project parameter bound to categories (instance or type) without a shared parameter file
Compact identity/placement info for elements: name, category, family, type, level, host
Geometry summary per element (mm): location point/curve, length, bounding box, area, volume
Find element ids by category and optional parameter value (equals/contains), optionally active view only
Create a footprint roof from a closed boundary (mm) with a roof type and level (resolved by name)
Create a curtain wall along a line (mm) using a curtain wall type and level
Create an area plan view for an area scheme and level (resolved by name)
Place areas at points (mm) in an area plan view
Create room/area/space separation lines from a polyline (mm) in a view
Join geometry between two elements (e.g. wall and floor)
Unjoin geometry between two previously-joined elements
Create a straight-run stair between two levels at a run line (mm) with a stairs type and width, via StairsEditScope
Create railings on an existing stairs/ramp host (Treads or Stringer position) with a railing type
